title: Hearing on maternal health in city jails
summary: The Council's Women and Gender Equity and Criminal Justice committees will hold a joint oversight hearing on maternal health care for pregnant and postpartum people in Department of Correction custody. The hearing also covers two bills on mental health protocols and gender-based violence reporting, plus three resolutions urging Albany to recognize postpartum mental illness in sentencing, limit restraints on pregnant people and postpone court dates for late-stage pregnancy. Correction Health Services data show 52 pregnant people in custody in 2025, down from 60 in 2024, with zero recorded maternal deaths both years.
